name: InputDeviceMask
meaning: InputMgr.presentMask and the wanted/present masks of InputMgr::CreateDevices

name: INPUTDEV_MASK_KEYBOARD
meaning: present |= 1 with the keyboard; SetAcquired case 1 acquires keyboard

name: INPUTDEV_MASK_JOYSTICK
meaning: present |= 2 with the joystick; SetAcquired case 2

name: INPUTDEV_MASK_MOUSE
meaning: present |= 4 with device3; SetAcquired case 4 (Mouse class) (inferred)
